hero.headline: How Peak Motion fills its schedule with *10-20 new patients* in 6 weeks
hero.subhead: This is the exact system we'd run for your practice: the ads, the funnel, the AI agent that books the consults, and the recovery loop that makes sure no lead is wasted.

engine_intro: New leads, old leads and missed calls all land with one AI agent that replies in seconds and books the consult. Anyone who doesn't book, no-shows or finishes care gets recycled back into reactivation instead of forgotten.
step_blurbs: Targeted ads put Peak Motion in front of active adults in Denver who want to get back to running and training.
Every click lands on a page built around one offer: the free discovery visit.
The agent texts and chats with every lead in seconds, answers questions and books them in.
Missed calls, no-shows and unbooked leads get followed up automatically, so nothing leaks.

ads.headline: Ads written around the patients you already help
ads.intro: Example creatives built with AI from what's on your site. In a real launch we test several angles and double down on whatever books the most consults.

items.primary_text: Started running again and your knee had other plans? Our Doctors of Physical Therapy build return-to-run plans one-on-one.
items.headline: Free 20-minute discovery visit
items.hook: Back to running, without the knee pain

items.primary_text: A full hour, one-on-one, with the same Doctor of Physical Therapy every visit.
items.headline: 60 minutes with a DPT, not 15

items.primary_text: Out of network? We give you superbills so you can submit for reimbursement.
items.headline: Cash-pay, superbills provided

funnel.headline: One page, one offer, one button
funnel.intro: Ad clicks never land on your homepage. They land on a page that says back exactly what the ad promised and asks for one thing.
points: Headline matches the ad they just clicked
Your real services, reviews and photos
One action: book the free discovery visit
The AI agent picks up the second they opt in

agent.headline: An agent that answers in seconds, at 11pm, on a Sunday
agent.intro: The practice that replies first usually wins the patient. This agent texts every new lead within seconds, answers their questions from your own website and books the consult on your calendar.
points: Knows your services, offer and policies
Never invents prices or medical advice
Offers two real times and books the one they pick
Hands off to your team whenever it should
agent.greeting: Hi! Thanks for reaching out to Peak Motion. What's going on that you'd like help with?
chips: My knee hurts when I run
Can I book a visit this week?

recovery.headline: Every lead that doesn't book gets another shot
recovery.intro: Most practices lose more patients to slow follow-up than to competitors. These run automatically.

close_intro: We're running this pilot with a handful of practices to build case studies. Here's what we commit to.
chat_context: Peak Motion Physical Therapy, Denver CO. Cash-pay, one-on-one 60 minute sessions with a Doctor of Physical Therapy. Services: sports injury rehab, back and neck pain, post-surgical rehab (ACL, rotator cuff), dry needling. Offer: free 20-minute discovery visit, in clinic. Out of network with insurance; provides superbills.
